rules.title: Traceable analysed sample set and denominators
rules.requirement: Every reportable table and figure identifies the analysed sample set and its denominators - number of samples (biological replicates per group), cells where applicable, and features tested versus filtered - plus the sampling time point where applicable and units.

automated_checks.name: omics_case_flow
automated_checks.requirement: Compare feature filtering, cell retention or biological-sample ledgers with matching result denominators; absent matching evidence is not_present.

rules.title: Effect estimates are not p-value-only
rules.requirement: Inferential results report the contrast or summary measure, the effect size (for example log2 fold change), its uncertainty (standard error or interval) when estimable, and effect direction; a p value or adjusted p value alone is insufficient.

rules.title: Cross-artifact numeric consistency
rules.requirement: The finalizer compares numbers, directions, units, labels, sample sizes, time points, and rounding across narrative, tables, figure captions, and manifest.

automated_checks.name: numeric_text_coverage
automated_checks.requirement: Trace draft and caption numbers at printed precision to canonical tables, result scalars, QC evidence or declared number sources; exclude package versions and years.

rules.title: Figure minimum information
rules.requirement: Figures require a caption, axis labels and units, sample size where relevant, readable legend, explicit reference-line or interval meaning, and an accessible colour palette.

rules.title: Methods-to-results traceability
rules.requirement: Methods, results, tables or figures, and limitations must be traceable to the declared study contract and executed analysis.

rules.title: Readable graphical presentation
rules.requirement: Avoid truncated scales, unreadable fonts, unexplained decorative elements, and visually misleading encodings.

rules.title: Journal profile differences
rules.requirement: A journal-specific preference is warning-only unless an explicit journal profile makes it mandatory.
